facts.business: The company manufactures, converts, distributes, and sells X-Ray films and NTR (Non-Tearable) films in matte and glossy finishes, procuring jumbo rolls and undertaking slitting and packaging at its Dadra facility.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Other financial assets and current assets include amounts recoverable from government department for which efforts for recovery are being made (refer Note No. 8, 13 and 14).

key_risks: Shrinking business of X-Ray Films due to increasing digitalization
Difficulty to sustain in market unless new products are launched
facts.related_party_note: The Company has duly complied with the provision of Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013. There is no Loan and Guarantee provided by the Company during the financial year. However, the Company has made investments details of which are given in the Notes No.5 to the Financial Statements.
